text: FAA guidance: when the control link is lost, try to reestablish the link; if it cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link. Manufacturer manuals: the action can be set to RTH, land, or hover; failsafe RTH activates after the remote controller signal is lost for more than six seconds; DJI Pilot 2 may display the precomputed RTH path when lighting allows; the aircraft remains in RTH even if the signal is restored; RTH can be triggered actively, by low battery, or by signal loss.
